questions.question: What is the subject of Asaph's lament in Psalm 74?
options: The enemy's destruction of God's sanctuary
The exodus of Israel out of Egypt
The king's victory over the nations
The wonders of God seen in creation
questions.answer: The enemy's destruction of God's sanctuary

questions.question: What does Asaph remind God of, to plead his cause?
options: That God will surely send a great deliverer from the line of David
That God is king and has worked salvation in the earth from of old
That God still remembers his ancient covenant made with Abraham
That God will gather his scattered exiles home from lands afar
questions.answer: That God is king and has worked salvation in the earth from of old

questions.question: The psalm asks God to remember the congregation he purchased of old.
Yet God my King is from of old, working salvation in the midst of the _____.
Remember how the enemy has _____ You, O LORD.
